content.text:
Resubmitted and accepted.

**What changed from the prior submission:**
- The duration now reads "Until **12 months** after the end of an individual's involvement in the services under this Agreement," using the numeral form so the 12-month ceiling is unambiguous in the operative text.
- I also took the verifier's optional tightening: the open-ended lead-in "During the Term of this Agreement and" is gone, so the covenant can never run longer than 12 months past a given individual's involvement.

**Position:** deviation cured at the fallback — mutual, limited to personnel directly involved in the services, 12-month cap, no no-hire, with the existing "Solicit" definition (general advertising and voluntary-inquiry carve-outs) retained verbatim. The preferred ask (no non-solicit on us at all) is noted in the rationale as the opening negotiating position.
